newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks roar higher at close, techs strong.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks roar higher at close, techs strong.

text.p: Taking their lead from bonds and a rally in the Dow Industrials, Nasdaq stocks shook off their doldrums and roared to a sharply higher close.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 13.74 points, or 1.22 percent at 1139.40 with advancers leading declining issues 2384 to 1608 on volume of about 482 million shares.

"Nasdaq is up in line with the Dow and has regained its losses from yesterday," said Ricky Harrington, technical analyst at Interestate/Johnson Lane, adding that a rally in high tech giant and Dow component International Business Machines helped boost the overall sector.
"Its strong as a bull," one trader said of Nasdaq's performance today.
Among the high techs, Intel Corp was up 5/8 at 81-1/4, Cisco Systems was up 1-1/2 at 53-3/8 and Ascend Communications Inc rose 2-1/4 to 53-7/8
NCI Building Systems Inc was up 1-3/4 at 30-1/4.
Wheat First Butcher Singer said it initiated coverage of the stock with a buy rating.
Qualcomm Inc was up 1/2 at 40-3/8. Rauscher Pierce said it began coverage of the stock as market performer. -A. Gustincic Wall Street desk 212-859-1730
